doc.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Memories of Rendón's Hamilton visit and goodbyes
summary: Both recall his performance with the Hamilton jazz band, then Rowe thanks him and ends the recording.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Okay. Well I’ve enjoyed reconnecting with you.
And I can flash back to when you came to Hamilton and the sound of those drums still gets to me.
It’s like — playing in my memory, and there’s something about it, it gets you in the heart.
Yeah. I really enjoyed playing with the Hamilton jazz band.
And playing with the director, I forgot his name but he was very gracious and very inviting.
And to see you playing. So I enjoyed it very much.
All right. Well thanks for illuminating us about your thoughts on this, and I wish you the best. I’m going to stop recording and we can chat for another minute or so, if that’s all right with you.
